## s12-v04 — argument map

Sated (sākṣatkṛta) with Your form-nectar (bhavadrūpaprasṛtāmṛtatarpitāḥ), thirst uprooted (unmūlitatṛṣo), drunk (mattā) — they wander (vicaranti) at will (yathāruci). The sated wander free: thirst uprooted, drunk on form-nectar.

### Open
- Whether 'mattā' means 'drunk' or 'intoxicated' is unresolved.
